# Adapter fix verification: 10 September 2026

The adapter fixes pass focused unit tests and live checks on eight available routes. The original client-list schema now returns only `pagination.first: 5` through Vercel Responses, and all three authenticated backend samples pass the real argument decoder, protobuf validation and pagination parser. No tool or customer action executes.

## Changes

- Numeric schema tokens remain JSON numbers through the OpenAI and Claude SDKs, including integer enum values above JavaScript's exact-integer range.
- With explicit fallback permission, OpenAI through Vercel Responses encodes absent optional non-nullable typed fields as null and removes only these markers from final arguments. It preserves required values, explicit nullable values and zero. It walks direct properties and array items, not alternatives or references. Partial streaming deltas remain provider-native.
- Claude nullable finite enums use an equivalent type-union form. Both typed and raw valid-null cases now return the requested null on the tested Gateway routes.
- Claude and Gemini Gateway root alternatives are rejected locally by default and removed only with explicit fallback permission and warnings. Google oneOf fallback no longer introduces a remotely rejected anyOf shape. Claude root oneOf is covered by a separate review regression check.

## Results and limits

- Full non-streaming run: the previous 32 cases on eight routes, 844 records and 502 HTTP attempts. All 251 valid attempted requests returned exactly the requested valid arguments. No HTTP schema errors.
- Streaming selection: six cases on the same routes, 152 records and 96 HTTP attempts. All 48 valid attempted requests returned exactly the requested valid arguments. This includes reduced raw/typed pagination and the original full client-list schema. No HTTP schema errors.
- Additional root-oneOf case: 32 records and 16 HTTP attempts across eight routes. All eight valid attempted requests returned exactly the requested valid arguments. The maintained matrix now has 33 cases.
- The three real backend pagination samples also passed. Saved pre-fix samples and the initial trial report remain unchanged.
- The two Vertex routes could not be reverified: Google credentials returned invalid_grant / invalid_rapt. Their earlier results are historical evidence, not verification of these fixes.
- Conflicting prompts still produce arguments outside original constraints, including explicitly weakened fallback constraints and some provider-enforced rules. One OpenAI conflicting multipleOf request produced malformed argument JSON. Four Claude streaming conflicting pagination requests produced malformed or interrupted calls. These are surfaced as errors, never successful tool execution.
- These samples demonstrate observed behaviour, not guaranteed provider enforcement. Keep backend argument validation and the adapter PR in draft pending Vertex verification and broader adoption decisions.

The full and streaming runs precede the final root-oneOf-only guard and fixture addition. The separate root-oneOf run verifies that final delta. Each directory retains its exact production source hashes and collection manifest. Probe mode was not repeated; the initial report retains independent raw-provider probes.
